title: Astrophysics and Cosmology
content: Astrophysics and cosmology apply the laws of physics to the grandest scales of the universe, tracing the lifecycle of matter from stellar interiors to the expansion of spacetime itself. This roadmap navigates the equations of stellar structure, high-energy plasma dynamics, general relativistic compact objects, and the global evolution of the Friedmann-Lemaître-Robertson-Walker metric.
